svg.title: Figure 3 V7: agent-directed research, comparable evidence and sequential decisions
svg.desc: Four full-width research lanes, ordered T04, PHS-2D, T07, T10. An initial observation column followed by stages with an Agent outer frame containing Agent intent and Action subframes, then Evidence below; pastel outlined block arrows join stages. Filled horizontal utilization bars use 0 to 1 axes when all values are within limit, 0 to 1.5 for T07 exceedances, otherwise 0 to 4.2: blue at or below the limit, red above the limit; no green or margin segments. Mathematical prediction and native diagnostic scope are labeled. PHS display P1 and P2 correspond to archived P2 and P3 respectively. Archived native renders plus two mesh-derived static T07 section views; no new simulation.
